expected: Callback identifies exact refs and ordered candidates; index selects remote and -1 fails resolution.

behaviors.description: Flatpakref suggested remote addition decisions and installation.
expected: Callback reason, source ID, name and URL match; remote persistence follows decision; accepted ref installs.

behaviors.description: Transaction option roundtrips and installation association.
expected: Boolean options roundtrip both ways; parent window accepts both protocols; installation path and profile match.

behaviors.description: Disabling dependencies excludes absent runtime from resolved operations.
expected: Only app resolves with flag enabled; default transaction installs both refs.

behaviors.description: No-deploy downloads update while preserving deployed commits.
expected: B payload is requested, A remains deployed, and fresh transaction getter accepts FALSE.

behaviors.description: No-pull deploys previously downloaded B without requests.
expected: Flag roundtrips and B deploys entirely offline.

behaviors.description: Explicit A update overrides advertised B.
expected: B deploys, explicit A update deploys A, unchanged runtime remains.
App and runtime retain exact installed commits.

behaviors.description: Explicit runtime automatic pinning and suppression.
expected: Normal runtime install pins; fresh unpinned runtime with disable-auto-pin stays unpinned.

mappings.rationale: Two remotes have unequal priorities; callback payload exact ordered candidates and refs, -1 prevents execution, index zero resolves runtime operation to high-priority remote and deploys commits.
Exact generic suggestion reason/source/name/URL for declined and accepted suggestions; remote enumeration asserts decision persistence; accepted flatpakref deploys exact fixture commits.
Compare owned installation path and user profile. Option roundtrips alone do not claim fixture-dependent option or authentication contracts.
Exact one-app resolved list excludes missing runtime with flag enabled, compared with default dependency install.
Getter TRUE, required payload request, exact A/runtime preserved, fresh getter FALSE.
Download B without deployment then no-pull deploy B with zero HTTP requests; getter both settings.
Install B then explicitly update to available A while server continues advertising B, verify exact A/runtime.
Ignored uninstall completes successfully and preserves exact app/runtime commits.
Public pinned-ref enumeration includes normally explicitly installed runtime; remove pin via setup CLI, reinstall with suppression and require empty public pinned list.
